summary: Private university in Istanbul with about 42 English-taught undergraduate programmes, from engineering and business to medicine, and a rolling international application.
about: Applications are checked against country or curriculum minimums, then reviewed by an admission committee. Predicted grades are accepted for the first application.

ib.text: IB Diploma: minimum 24 on BAU's USA-requirements page; no general IB or Course Results rule found. Meeting minimums does not guarantee a place. Ask BAU for your country page.

languageOfInstruction.note: The programme list tags most undergraduate programmes as English and the rest as Turkish, including Law and several health and music programmes.

admissionRoutes.text: BAU's country page for US applicants lists an IB Diploma minimum of 24. A general international IB page was not found, so confirm the rule for your school's country.
No Course Results route is published. Admission staff also weigh the main curriculum and success in related courses; ask BAU about certificate-only applications.

notes: Documents: passport, high-school transcript, diploma if available, motivation letter for Medicine, and a portfolio for Cartoon and Animation, Textile and Fashion Design or Conservatory. Without a diploma you can apply with a latest transcript and predicted grades.

No Fall 2027 dates are published. For 2026-27 BAU extended applications and registration to 30 Nov 2026, subject to programme availability. A paid deposit by the stated date secures the official acceptance letter.

English proof is not needed to apply; it is shown after enrolment. TOEFL iBT 72 (general), 85 (Dentistry, Pharmacy), 96 (Medicine, ELT, Translation); PTE 55/71/78; BAU's own exam 60/70. Exempt if you did your last three school years in an English-speaking country. No IB English exemption is stated.

Tuition 2026-27, per year: USD 8,500 (Economics, Administrative and Social Sciences; Architecture and Design; Communication; Educational Sciences; Health Sciences; Gastronomy; Conservatory), USD 9,000 (Engineering and Natural Sciences), USD 12,000 (AI Engineering), USD 28,000 (Medicine). Another BAU page shows older, lower figures.
Check the country-requirements page for your school system; BAU's pages list different minimums by country.
